decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - Detailed drawings of the following items (at a scale of 1:10 internally (1:5 for joinery) and 1:50 externally for new work to the building) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval in writing, prior to the work commencing. 
(i)	New openings in existing walls
(ii)	External seating enclosures

The works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 4 - All restorative works and repairs to the building shall match original adjacent work in terms of the choice of materials (excluding new glazed entrance canopy), method of construction and finished appearance. The minimum of existing material is to be affected during interventions.
description: Demolition of existing extensions and replacement with a new link structure together with associated internal alterations (Listed Building)
